response.rationale: The expected behavior for 'Conflict Due to Outdated Information' requires prioritizing up-to-date information. The model provided an answer based on document d5, which is historically outdated (SPb IFMO won in 2013, while many subsequent finals have occurred). Since the model failed to identify or provide the actual most recent winner, it did not prioritize up-to-date information, thus violating the rubric.
